requirements.sourceQuote: Academic admission requirements include a good Bachelor's degree that is related to Chinese Studies/Modern Sinology.

To apply for the MA programme in Modern Sinology, you will need level 5 from HSK or TOCFL Band B Level 3 and at least 120 CP in Sinology, including credits totalling at least 24 CP from subjects on Modern China in at least two of the following areas: history, religion, politics, law, society or economy.

To apply for the MA programme in Modern Sinology, you will need level 5 from HSK or TOCFL Band B Level 3 and at least 120 CP in Sinology, including credits totalling at least 24 CP from subjects on Modern China in at least two of the following areas: history, religion, politics, law, society or economy.

To apply for the MA programme in Modern Sinology, you will need level 5 from HSK or TOCFL Band B Level 3 and at least 120 CP in Sinology, including credits totalling at least 24 CP from subjects on Modern China in at least two of the following areas: history, religion, politics, law, society or economy.

To apply for the MA programme in Modern Sinology, you will need level 5 from HSK or TOCFL Band B Level 3 and at least 120 CP in Sinology, including credits totalling at least 24 CP from subjects on Modern China in at least two of the following areas: history, religion, politics, law, society or economy.

deadlines.dateText: For the Master's programme "Modern Sinology" it is possible to apply at any time until **30 September** for the winter semester. International applicants who require a visa should apply well in advance to ensure that the visa is issued in time for the start of the teaching period in October.
